left_card.build_scope: Responsive Seed Streamlit UI, authenticated Snowflake reads, policy, editor, and download.
left_card.business_case: It replaces manual go or no-go and proposal kickoff with a replayable Bid Room.
left_card.experience: A large verdict and four dimensions lead directly into Win Position selection.
left_card.mechanism: A decision ledger orders verdict, strategy, score map, blueprint, draft, review, and replay.
left_card.problem: Bid qualification, strategy, drafting, and review are split across tools and judgment.
left_card.proof_plan: Compare two suppliers, switch strategy, inspect the proposal, then reload the persisted run.
left_card.required_technology: Snowpark decides; Cortex Code writes one Snowflake run with every downstream artifact.
left_card.user: A small B2G team deciding whether to pursue and how to own the response.

right_card.build_scope: Responsive Seed application with three states, score map, proposal, review, and replay.
right_card.business_case: It directs writing effort before days are spent and retains reusable bid evidence.
right_card.experience: A weighted score map shows readiness, asset, gap, and planned claim before drafting.
right_card.mechanism: The matrix drives Win Positions, criterion claims, proposal preview, review, and replay.
right_card.problem: Eligible bids still hide where points are won, which proof supports them, and what is missing.
right_card.proof_plan: Show the 40-point row, switch supplier and position, rebuild, then replay the run.
right_card.required_technology: Snowflake stores the graph and run; Snowpark decides and Cortex Code authors artifacts.
right_card.user: A proposal lead allocating effort by official weight while binding proof and owners.
